name: Post-Engagement - Report Structure
description: Post-Engagement - Report Structure - reference (methodology, not a runnable command).
notes:
Report components: attack chain narrative; executive summary (non-technical); detailed findings (risk rating, impact, remediation, external refs); steps to reproduce each finding; near/medium/long-term recommendations; appendices (scope, OSINT, cracked passwords, ports/services, compromised hosts/accounts, files transferred, system modifications, AD analysis, scan data).
Versioning: DRAFT (for client review) -> FINAL (after feedback). Post-remediation table: # | Severity | Title | Status (Remediated/Not Remediated).

examples.label: Executive Summary — one page, business language, no CVEs
examples.command: # Risk summary (Critical/High/Medium/Low counts) + top 3 findings in plain English

examples.label: Technical Findings — one section per vuln
examples.command: # Title | CVSS | Description | PoC Steps | Evidence (screenshots) | Remediation

examples.label: Attack Chain Narrative — tell the story
examples.command: # Initial foothold → lateral movement → DA compromise → timeline with timestamps
